On Sun, Jun 9, 2013 at 4:22 PM, Eric Hare <eric...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hello,

I'm having some issues with my Shiny app hosted on glimmer.  I deleted my files, renamed my github repository and then recloned it.  Well, now when I browse to the URL http://glimmer.rstudio.com/erichare/pelica , I get the message:

"ERROR: argument "metaHandler" is missing, with no default"

However, if i so much as make a symlink from the pelica directory to a new directory, such as Pelica, everything works fine. See: http://glimmer.rstudio.com/erichare/Pelica which is just a symlink. Any ideas why this might be happening?

Thank you!
